count_definition: PREREG.md section 2.5, Contributing night (the floor unit, DP-21; identical for E1 and E2): a non-excluded night in the window, matured to t+20, carrying >= 30 eligible rows with both terciles non-empty and a defined d*_t (directly, or by section 2.2's trailing-20-night fallback on a 1-2-survivor night; a zero-survivor night is not a non-contributing night, it is excluded whole under payload_disabled_runs). A night that survives the night-level filters but carries fewer than 30 eligible rows is a non-contributing night, not an exclusion, printed in the funnel. Eligible row filter is section 2.1 (overall_score not null, dominant_direction in bullish/bearish, >= 60 prior split-adjusted daily bars, session t+1 open exists, bars cover t+1..t+20 without a gap), applied after the section 2.4 exclusions union (manual_runs, non_session_runs, uncorroborated_publication_runs, payload_disabled_runs) and the mixed-direction and >25%-mixed / >10%-ungradeable whole-night exclusions.
